readmeExcerpt: This folder contains a LangChain-based vector-search sample for Oracle AI Database. It uses `langchain-oracledb` with `OpenAIEmbeddings` to persist sample texts into Oracle AI Database and then runs a similarity search with `OracleVS`.
highlights: OPENAI_API_KEY set in your environment, or available for interactive prompt entry
